# The MSVC /analyze findings on the new core that the static analysis gate accepts (ADR-0040 item 3,
# .github/scripts/static-findings.py), one "<file>|<warning>|<message>" per line, once for each line
# of the file that has it. A finding that is not here fails the static-analysis job of windows.yml.
#
# The findings of src/Core when the gate started (2026-10-22, the first run of the job):
# - Crypto.c, CryptoMlKem.c: the result of BCryptSetProperty with the ML-KEM parameter set is not
#   checked, on the provider and on each new key; the key's BCryptFinalizeKeyPair and export after it
#   are
# - CryptoCert.c: CryptoCertEncodeExtension sets Value.pbData to NULL first, for every extension
#   that num_ext counts, which the analysis does not follow
src/Core/Crypto.c|C6031|Return value ignored: 'BCryptSetProperty'.
src/Core/CryptoMlKem.c|C6031|Return value ignored: 'BCryptSetProperty'.
src/Core/CryptoCert.c|C6001|Using uninitialized memory 'ext.Value.pbData'.
